The Secret Space Age Is About to Go Public

Written by Dr Michael Salla on September 14, 2026. Posted in Featured, Interviews.

FIRST CONTACT IN THE 2030s? Galactic Constitution, Inner Earth & Humanity’s Space Future

Brad Johnson returns to Exopolitics Today with Dr. Michael Salla for a wide-ranging conversation about what he believes could be a dramatic acceleration in humanity’s relationship with space and extraterrestrial civilizations.

Brad shares new information from his contacts suggesting that some form of global first contact may now happen in the 2030s, much earlier than he previously expected. He also discusses what he describes as a developing “galactic constitution” involving humanity, Inner Earth civilizations, and extraterrestrial groups, with agreements that could eventually open access to the Moon, Mars, and parts of the Inner Earth.

The conversation moves into some extraordinary territory: hidden technologies emerging from secret programs, anti-gravity and portal systems, consciousness-controlled orbs, temporary “avatar” bodies, ancient installations beneath Antarctica, and the possibility that humanity is being prepared to become a true spacefaring civilization.

They also discuss Elon Musk and the role he may play in bringing advanced aerospace technology into the public arena, the Moon as a multi-civilization treaty zone, Inner Earth societies numbering in the billions, and Brad’s controversial perspective on Venus and the possibility of highly advanced human civilizations already existing elsewhere in our solar system.

Are the rockets, lunar programs, Space Force announcements, and growing race toward Mars simply the beginning of a much larger transition?

This conversation connects the dots between disclosure, advanced technology, Inner Earth, extraterrestrial contact, and what Brad believes may unfold before the end of the next decade.
